title: Moving to Binghamton in 1969 and marrying his wife
summary: After freelancing through the 1960s he moved to Binghamton in 1969 to marry a pianist he first met in California while with Tatum.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Now, you began to -- after about 1960, what were you doing?

Oh, about -- let's see, quite a few things. 1960, I still would do a few things once in a while with Benny Goodman and Rose Murphy and a few others. I was really freelancing during those years up until, I might say, 1969, when I --
Is that when you moved here?
That's when I moved to Binghamton, yes.
What possessed you to move to Binghamton?
Well, I think I will put the blame on

my present wife. She is really the cause of me being here in Binghamton and of course, she happens to be a musician also. She plays piano. Since we have been married, it has been quite a change for me for the best, these last ten years.
So now, did you meet her in Binghamton or did you meet her --
I met her quite a few years ago, not here in Binghamton, but out in California. She was playing out there, doing a single on piano, and that's when I first met her. I was with Art Tatum.
Oh, you met her long, long ago.

A long time ago, yes, right. And of course, that's when we had first met and of course, we had kept up contact through the years up until a little before -- let's say the mid-'60s, like '66 or '67, where I met her again in Philadelphia at a friend's house and that was our second meeting and of course, we -- you might say we got a little tighter in the relationship with each other that finally, it just happened that I asked her to marry me and I came on up here to Binghamton, where she had lived for quite a few years before then.
Oh, she had been living -- she had a home here.
Yeah, she had a home here, yes.
